errors.text_span: wobei die Werte als normierte Indizes dargestellt sind, mit einem Basiswert von 1,00, der vermutlich einem Referenzjahr entspricht
errors.evidence: The description introduces concepts like "normalized indices," "base value," and "reference year" which are not explicitly stated in the figure. This is an interpretation of the data, not a direct description of the visual elements.
The data point for the year 2012 is visibly below the 1.00 grid line. Its value is approximately 0.99, not 1.00.
